claims.quote: "Les auteurs de cette attaque doivent être retrouvés et condamnés avec la plus grande sévérité", a écrit sur X Marine Le Pen en remerciant les forces de l'ordre "qui seront mobilisées jusque tard dans la nuit pour protéger nos compatriotes face aux hordes d'extrême gauche".
claims.speaker: Marine Le Pen (RN)
claims.en: "The perpetrators of this attack must be found and condemned with the utmost severity," wrote on X Marine Le Pen, thanking the police "who will be mobilized until late in the night to protect our compatriots from the hordes of extreme left".

claims.quote: France's Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said on Saturday that demonstrations across the country were largely peaceful, despite what he called an "extraordinary" level of violence from some groups of rioters, blaming far-left extremist groups for attacks on security forces.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)

claims.quote: Plusieurs manifestants, dont des mineurs, ont été grièvement blessés ou mutilés depuis la mi-septembre lors d'opérations de maintien de l'ordre, tandis que 1193 policiers et gendarmes ont été blessés, selon le ministre de l'Intérieur. (dal/ats/afp)
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)
claims.en: Several demonstrators, including minors, have been seriously injured or maimed since mid-September during law enforcement operations, while 1193 police officers and gendarmes have been injured, according to the Minister of the Interior. (dal/ats/afp)

claims.quote: Marine Le Pen of the far-right National Rally also blamed France Unbowed for fueling the violence.
claims.speaker: Marine Le Pen (RN)

claims.quote: Nuñez said late on Thursday that radical groups had called on social media for violent Halloween gatherings and that the biggest threat to public order would probably come after mainstream cost-of-living demonstrations had officially ended.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)

claims.quote: "We went to this meeting to discuss our demands, but above all the last four weeks of mobilisation, which have been marked by unprecedented police violence," said Manon Moret, secretary-general of the student union Unef.
claims.speaker: student organisations

claims.quote: Clara Privé, trésorière de l'Union nationale des étudiants de France (Unef) dénonce sur BFMTV les "manœuvres de la préfecture de police de Paris pour empêcher l'ensemble des organisations syndicales de manifester là où ils le souhaitent".
claims.speaker: student organisations
claims.en: Clara Privé, treasurer of the Union nationale des étudiants de France (Unef) denounces on BFMTV the "manoeuvres of the Paris police prefecture to prevent all the trade union organizations from demonstrating where they wish".

claims.quote: Le Premier secrétaire du Parti socialiste, Olivier Faure, a écrit au ministre de l'Intérieur, Laurent Nuñez, au sujet des mobilisations de samedi dernier, lors desquelles des militants d'ultradroite s'en sont pris à des manifestants dans plusieurs villes.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)
claims.en: The Prime Secretary of the Socialist Party, Olivier Faure, wrote to the Minister of the Interior, Laurent Nuñez, about the mobilizations last Saturday, during which ultra-right wing activists attacked demonstrators in several cities.

claims.quote: Selon la CGT, 22 000 personnes défilaient dans les rues le 17 octobre : « La manifestation a rassemblé lycéens, étudiants, syndicats et gilets jaunes », rapporte un reportage d’Ici Isère , tous réunis « pour demander plus de moyens pour l’éducation nationale mais aussi plus de justice sociale ».
claims.speaker: unions
claims.en: According to the CGT, 22,000 people marched into the streets on 17 October: "The demonstration brought together high school students, students, trade unions and yellow vests", reports a report by Ici Isère, all gathered "to demand more means for national education but also more social justice".

claims.quote: Most of the French political establishment, including the prime minister, has blamed the far-left party France Unbowed for fueling violence and using the protests to gain electoral advantage.
claims.speaker: Sébastien Lecornu (Prime Minister)

claims.quote: In contrast, Marine Le Pen, the presidential candidate of the far-right National Rally party, has expressed support for police forces, deemed the government’s response inadequate, and blamed the far left for stoking violence.
claims.speaker: Marine Le Pen (RN)

claims.quote: “As the riots can be blamed on extremist elements of the far left, Marine Le Pen’s far-right National Rally can lay claim to be the party of law and order, and position itself as the only realistic governing alternative for French citizens who want to see radical change,” he said.
claims.speaker: Marine Le Pen (RN)

claims.quote: And many of those identified by Mr Macron – the ‘far-left groups’ he says were behind the violence – seem to be in sympathy with only one main French political figure, and that is Mr Mélenchon – a 75-year-old who campaigns for a retirement age of 60.
claims.speaker: Emmanuel Macron (President)

claims.quote: Some political analysts have said that with voter turnout among 18 to 25-year-olds often low, the association of Mr Mélenchon with the student protests may well provide the final lift he needs to get into the last two against Ms Le Pen.
claims.speaker: Jean-Luc Mélenchon (LFI)

claims.quote: « Les policiers et les gendarmes avaient une mission, c’était d’éviter les pillages et de mettre un terme aux exactions de la mouvance d’extrême gauche » pendant les cortèges, a insisté le ministre de l’intérieur.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)
claims.en: " The police and gendarmes had a mission to avoid looting and to stop the abuses of the far left movement " during the processions, the minister of the interior insisted.

claims.quote: A Nice, par exemple, une centaine de "militants d'ultradroite masqués" ont convergé vers le centre-ville pour "affronter physiquement les manifestants", selon la préfecture des Alpes-Maritimes, et onze personnes ont été placées en garde à vue.
claims.speaker: a prefect
claims.en: In Nice, for example, a hundred "masked ultra-right militias" converged towards the city centre to "face the demonstrators physically", according to the Alpes-Maritimes prefecture, and eleven people were placed in police custody.

claims.quote: «Les policiers et les gendarmes avaient une mission, c'était d'éviter les pillages et de mettre un terme aux exactions de la mouvance d'extrême gauche» pendant les cortèges, a insisté le ministre de l'Intérieur.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)
claims.en: "The police and gendarmes had a mission, it was to avoid looting and put an end to the abuses of the far left movement" during the processions, insisted the Minister of the Interior.

claims.quote: «Ils ont été utilisés, en particulier le 17, pour faire venir des jeunes ou des moins jeunes sur les lieux de délinquance, d’attaque, de pillage» , a assuré le chef de l’État, décrivant «aujourd’hui une grande confusion, une forme d’excitation permanente qui est en train de se faire, une fascination pour la violence» .
claims.speaker: Emmanuel Macron (President)
claims.en: "They were used, in particular on the 17th, to bring young or old people to the places of delinquency, attack, looting", assured the head of state, describing "today a great confusion, a form of permanent excitement that is being made, a fascination for violence".

claims.quote: À Nice, par exemple, une centaine de « militants d’ultradroite masqués » ont convergé vers le centre-ville pour « affronter physiquement les manifestants » , selon la préfecture des Alpes-Maritimes, et onze personnes ont été placées en garde à vue.
claims.speaker: a prefect
claims.en: In Nice, for example, about 100 "masked ultra-right activists" converged towards the city centre to "physically face the demonstrators", according to the Alpes-Maritimes prefecture, and eleven people were placed in custody.

claims.quote: Samedi, 1 435 personnes ont été interpellées en France lors des manifestations pour le pouvoir d'achat et la défense des services publics, dont plus de cent pour détention d'armes par destination, selon le ministre de l'Intérieur Laurent Nuñez.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)
claims.en: On Saturday, 1,435 people were arrested in France during the demonstrations for the purchasing power and the defence of public services, including more than a hundred for possession of weapons by destination, according to the Minister of the Interior Laurent Nuñez.

claims.quote: En marge des manifestations contre la vie chère ayant réuni au moins 410 000 manifestants, samedi 24 octobre, "on a observé dans au moins deux villes – c'était le cas à Nice et à Montpellier – la présence de militants de l'ultradroite qui cherchaient à affronter l'ultragauche, en tout cas à protéger eux-mêmes les commerces" , a affirmé Laurent Nuñez lors d'un point-presse.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)
claims.en: On the sidelines of the protests against expensive living, which brought together at least 410,000 demonstrators on Saturday 24 October, "we have seen in at least two cities – in Nice and Montpellier – the presence of ultra-right-wing activists who were trying to face the ultra-left, at least to protect the shops themselves," Laurent Nuñez said at a press point.

claims.quote: Nearly 1,000 people were arrested in nationwide protests in France, Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said Saturday, after demonstrations over the high cost of living and the country's education system earlier in the day remained largely peaceful.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)

claims.quote: “Bravant un important dispositif policier, ainsi que la pluie et les intempéries”, “près d’un demi-million de personnes ont résisté à Macron” samedi 24 octobre, en manifestant à travers la France pour “défendre le pouvoir d’achat et réclamer de meilleurs services publics”, rapporte le quotidien espagnol.
claims.speaker: Emmanuel Macron (President)
claims.en: "Breaking up an important police system, as well as the rain and the weather," "almost half a million people resisted Macron" on Saturday 24 October, protesting across France to "defend purchasing power and demand better public services," reports the Spanish daily.

claims.speaker: unions
claims.en: According to the authorities, more than 20,000 demonstrators (50 000 according to participants) had gathered in Nantes on Saturday 17 October to protest against expensive life and bring about a convergence of struggles between Yellow Gilets, trade unions, high school students and students.

claims.quote: Des manifestants et des lycéens se rassemblent dans toute la France pour relancer le mouvement né en 2018 et dénoncer la hausse du coût de la vie et la baisse du pouvoir d’achat.
claims.speaker: student organisations
claims.en: Protesters and high school students gather throughout France to revive the movement born in 2018 and denounce the rising cost of living and the decline in purchasing power.

claims.quote: Préfet des Alpes-Maritimes says during the dispersal of the protest far-right and far-left protesters clashed.
claims.speaker: a prefect

claims.quote: Quelque 11 000 personnes selon la préfecture, 26 000 selon les organisateurs, participaient samedi à midi à la manifestation contre le Rassemblement national à Orléans qui accueille ce week-end un congrès du parti d’extrême droite.
claims.speaker: a prefect
claims.en: Some 11,000 people according to the prefecture, 26,000 according to the organizers, participated Saturday at noon in the demonstration against the National Rally in Orléans which hosts this weekend a congress of the far right party.

claims.quote: Les manifestations pour le pouvoir d'achat et la défense des services publics se sont "bien passées", selon le ministre de l'Intérieur, qui déplore toutefois la présence de "casseurs" dans plusieurs villes.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)
claims.en: The demonstrations for purchasing power and the defence of public services have gone "well", according to the Minister of the Interior, who deplores however the presence of "casseurs" in several cities.

claims.quote: Of course, many protesters – from students to union groups – have said they will march anyway regardless of the bans or rules around where and when they can demonstrate.
claims.speaker: unions

claims.quote: They broke away and sought to commit acts of violence,' said interior minister Laurent Nunez, accusing far-Left activists and criminal gangs of seeking to foment trouble.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)

claims.quote: Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said: 'We are seeing numerous calls from the radical far-Left movement to commit acts of violence.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)

claims.quote: À l'image d'autres figures de La France insoumise, son leader, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, appelle les personnes voulant participer à la manifestation parisienne à se rassembler porte d'Italie cet après-midi.
claims.speaker: Jean-Luc Mélenchon (LFI)
claims.en: Like other figures from La France insoumée, its leader, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, calls on people wishing to participate in the Parisian demonstration to gather at the gate of Italy this afternoon.

claims.quote: Security chiefs are said to be particularly concerned over potential clashes in Orleans, where protests are expected against Marine Le Pen's National Rally during the far-Right party's two-day conference.
claims.speaker: Marine Le Pen (RN)

claims.quote: Plus tôt dans la journée, entre 13.000 et 26.000 manifestants (selon la préfecture ou les organisateurs) ont défilé près du centre-ville contre la présence du parti d'extrême droite.
claims.speaker: a prefect
claims.en: Earlier in the day, between 13,000 and 26,000 demonstrators (depending on the prefecture or organizers) marched near the city center against the presence of the far right party.

claims.quote: Plusieurs milliers de personnes ont manifesté samedi à Istanbul et Ankara pour dénoncer la pression constante du pouvoir du président Recep Tayyip Erdogan sur la presse, entre poursuites judiciaires et fermetures de médias.Gokhan Durmus, président du Syndicat des journalistes de Turquie, a décrit une évolution dans la nature des "attaques du gouvernement" islamo-conservateur du président Erdogan.
claims.speaker: unions
claims.en: Several thousand people demonstrated on Saturday in Istanbul and Ankara to denounce the constant pressure of President Recep Tayyip Erdogan's power over the press, between prosecution and media closures.Gokhan Durmus, president of the Turkish Journalists Union, described an evolution in the nature of President Erdogan's "government attacks".

claims.quote: Le ministre de l’Intérieur a affirmé que «de nombreux appels de la mouvance d’ultragauche et de l’extrême-gauche radicale» à «commettre des pillages et des exactions» ont été repérés sur les réseaux sociaux.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)
claims.en: The Minister of the Interior said that "many calls from the ultra-left movement and the radical extreme left" to "combate looting and abuses" were detected on social networks.

claims.quote: President Emmanuel Macron met high-school students' representatives on Friday ahead of Saturday's protests, and although they said he had made clear commitments to them, they said students should "continue to mobilise".
claims.speaker: Emmanuel Macron (President)

claims.quote: Une semaine après la mobilisation des lycéens et des « gilets jaunes » contre « la vie chère » du 17 octobre , qui a rassemblé 550 000 personnes à travers le pays, selon les chiffres officiels, un nouvel appel à manifester a été lancé au niveau national pour ce samedi 24 octobre.
claims.speaker: student organisations
claims.en: One week after the mobilization of high school students and " yellow vests " against " expensive life " on 17 October, which gathered 550,000 people across the country, according to official figures, a new call to protest was launched at the national level for this Saturday, 24 October.

claims.quote: Accusant le pouvoir de chercher à provoquer le désordre pour justifier une nouvelle répression, il appelle les manifestants à faire preuve « d’ordre et de discipline » et à respecter les lieux de rendez-vous communiqués par les syndicats, afin de poursuivre la mobilisation contre la vie chère.
claims.speaker: unions
claims.en: Accusing the power to seek to provoke disorder to justify further repression, he calls on the demonstrators to show "order and discipline" and to respect the places of meeting communicated by the unions, in order to continue the mobilization against expensive life.

claims.quote: Trump has blamed the unrest on migrants and Muslims, following a familiar playbook that has featured in his politics for more than a decade.
claims.speaker: Donald Trump

claims.quote: Messages urging violence and looting were already circulating on social media, Nuñez warned, as authorities face mounting pressure to restore order after protests against the rising cost of living turned chaotic last weekend.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)

claims.quote: France will deploy some 70,000 police officers and gendarmes nationwide during a fresh round of protests this weekend, Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said on Friday, as President Emmanuel Macron met with student organisations at the Élysée palace for the first time since the high school protests started more than a month ago.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)

claims.quote: Messages urging violence and looting were already circulating on social media, Nunez warned, as authorities faced mounting pressure to restore order after chaotic protests against the rising cost of living last weekend.
claims.speaker: Laurent Nuñez (Interior Minister)

claims.quote: In the city of Orleans south of the capital, 20,000 to 30,000 people are expected to protest against Marine Le Pen’s far-right National Rally as it holds its party congress there, but the prefecture said the gathering would be barred from the city centre.
claims.speaker: a prefect

claims.quote: The Paris police prefecture previously said the ban was necessary, given the risk of street violence after groups of masked youth clashed with police forces, looted shops and torched cars over the weekend.
claims.speaker: a prefect

claims.quote: Macron blamed the weekend's violence on 'actions led by radical far-left groups who aimed to bring the Republic down,' in addition to criminals who came to loot.
claims.speaker: Emmanuel Macron (President)

claims.quote: The letter refers to reports published earlier this week by investigative news outlet Mediapart, which alleged that Lecornu’s government had pressured intelligence agencies to blame LFI for the unrest.
claims.speaker: Sébastien Lecornu (Prime Minister)

claims.quote: Emmanuel Macron a vivement mis en cause mercredi 21 octobre des "dirigeants étrangers" qui, selon lui, exploitent les violences récentes en France pour servir leurs intérêts politiques.
claims.speaker: Emmanuel Macron (President)
claims.en: Emmanuel Macron strongly challenged on Wednesday 21 October "foreign leaders" who, according to him, exploit recent violence in France to serve their political interests.

claims.quote: Lundi, lors d'un meeting dans le Kansas, Donald Trump avait longuement évoqué une France selon lui "prise d'assaut, pillée et incendiée par des migrants, des jihadistes et des communistes".
claims.speaker: Donald Trump
claims.en: On Monday, during a meeting in Kansas, Donald Trump had at length evoked a France, according to him, "captured, looted and burned by migrants, jihadists and communists".

claims.quote: The Paris police prefecture said the ban was necessary given the risk of street violence that erupted over the weekend, when groups of masked youth clashed with police forces, looted shops and torched cars.
claims.speaker: a prefect

claims.quote: The French foreign ministry hit back at criticism from the United States over the riots sweeping France on Thursday, days after US president Donald Trump drove controversy by claiming without evidence that migrants were fuelling the riots.
claims.speaker: Donald Trump

claims.quote: President Trump sparked anger in Europe over the weekend when he joined with the Kremlin in blaming the ongoing riots in France on “mass immigration”.
claims.speaker: Donald Trump

claims.quote: Vice President JD Vance echoed the messaging on social media, attributing the unrest to "third world" immigration and failure to assimilate, while warning American voters of a similar outcome should they support Democrats in the November midterms.
claims.speaker: JD Vance

claims.quote: France’s main student union UNEF has called for further protests on Saturday and said they won’t give up until their demands are met.

claims.quote: The Paris prefecture previously said the ban was necessary, given the risk of street violence after groups of masked youth clashed with officers, looted shops and torched cars over the weekend.

Manifestation du 5 novembre 2026 pour défendre les salaires, les services publics, l’emploi et l’industrie, sur la place de la Rotonde à Aix-en-Provence (Bouches-du-Rhône). À Aix-en-Provence, la manifestation a rassemblé plus de 4 000 personnes selon le journal La Provence, 15 000 selon la CGT et 2
media.en: Demonstration of 5 November 2026 to defend wages, public services, employment and industry, on the Rotonde Square in Aix-en-Provence (Bouches-du-Rhône). In Aix-en-Provence, the event brought together more than 4,000 people according to the newspaper La Provence, 15,000 according to the CGT and 2

La manifestation du 31 octobre est un rassemblement contre la vie chère et les conditions d'études. À Aix-en-Provence, elle a réunie 700 personnes selon les forces de l'ordre et s'est tenue alors qu'un arrêté préfectoral interdisait les manifestations et rassemblements revendicatifs non déclarés dan
media.en: The demonstration on October 31st is a rally against expensive life and study conditions. In Aix-en-Provence, it brought together 700 people according to the law enforcement agencies and was held while a prefectural order prohibited undeclared demonstrations and rallies in the city.
